applicability.reason: Verify complete selected-app report instances produce only fully verified parser-ready segment bytes.
Reject foreign scope, unsafe destinations, malformed metadata, damaged bytes and incomplete segment inventories.
Reject empty, partial, oversized or failed segment reads without returning or persisting partial observations.
Bind segment retrieval to the selected app, supported report family, verified instance and complete segment listing.
Do not attach API credentials to signed downloads; reject redirects and keep signed URLs out of results and errors.
Enforce declared per-segment, segment-count, aggregate-byte and request-time bounds.
This backend transport packet changes no visible UI, focus, keyboard, or assistive-technology behavior.
The transport is GET-only; acceptance runs offline with a mocked opener and does not contact Apple or mutate a provider.

checks.requirement: Download every segment for a complete verified selected-app report instance and return only id, size, checksum and bytes.
Reject foreign ancestry, unsafe signed destinations, malformed segment metadata, byte-size/checksum mismatch and partial paging.
On empty, incomplete or failed segment reads, fail closed without returning a partial instance.
Verify app, supported report family, instance and complete segment inventory before requesting any signed bytes.
Send no Apple API authorization to a signed URL; block redirects and exclude signed URLs from results and errors.
Enforce the specified 16 MiB per-segment cap, 50-segment cap, aggregate byte cap and 15-second request timeout.
Use HTTPS GET only for signed report bytes; no Apple credentials, live provider request or external write in this packet.
